text:
sam: Quick heads-up exports map regression in @redwood-inference/sdk v1.7.0 broke our Cloudflare Workers sample — import-time error: "Failed to resolve module specifier './dist/index.cjs.js'" when running `wrangler dev`.

maria: Yikes. Are samples still referencing require anywhere? Workers are ESM-only.

sam: Sample uses `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk'`. Bundler picked the CJS fallback because of the exports conditional ordering; Node was fine but edge bundles hit the CJS path.

alex: Can you paste the exports block from package.json? That will tell us which conditionals are present.

sam: snippet: { "exports": { ".": { "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "types": "./dist/index.d.ts" } } }

kevin: Ok. Some edge bundlers ignore the import condition and fall back to require/default. Worse, we accidentally left `withAuthRetry` only exported from the CJS build during the refactor. Edge runtime resolves wrong entry and then sees the helper missing.

maria: Which symbol errors at runtime?

kevin: `withAuthRetry` — Worker trace is `TypeError: undefined is not a function` inside handleRequest. CI also flagged samples.

ci-bot: build/sample-apps  master #482 - test: samples/edge-worker imports  failed - log: "Cannot read property 'withAuthRetry' of undefined"

maria: Two remediation paths: 1) change exports so edge picks the mjs entry (explicit default/import ordering), or 2) re-export the helper from the ESM bundle and release a patch.

kevin: Re-exporting from ESM + adding an automated sample bundling test (esbuild target=browser/worker) is safest. Also add an exports+types test so TS consumers don't break.

sam: I'll open a PR to re-export and add tests. I'll also scrub samples for any require() usage.

alex: Add a short onboarding note in README about package exports + edge bundlers: checklist and quick fixes.

maria: Suggested checklist: prefer ESM imports in samples; include explicit `import` or `default` pointing to mjs; include `types` in exports; add an esbuild worker example; show how to pin working SDK versions.

sam: Temporary mitigation: updated sample to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.mjs'` until patch cuts. Ugly but buys time. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234 (adds ESM re-export, tests, docs).

kevin: Also add changelog entry for v1.7.0 exports change and guidance for customers. Postmortem action items: SDK - re-export helper in ESM, add exports+types tests, update changelog. Samples - remove implicit require paths, add worker esbuild example. Docs - onboarding note + troubleshooting.

sam: Linking PR in #support so triage can route incoming tickets. Will cut 1.7.1 once merged.

maria: Ping me for review. :thumbsup:

kevin: I'll update Dedicated quickstart snippets after patch is published.

sam: Shipping patch now. :ship:
